summary: Retest for hero-photo cleanup matrix (no more floating cutout nails/hand in #hero, hero uses new client photos velvet-nude-hands.jpg / floral-art-hands.jpg, service cards & gallery use /nehty/ photos). Re-ran backend suite (5 tests passed) and 8 existing browser checks by name (7 passed, 1 flaky-passed-on-rerun). Added 3 new browser checks for the new hero/photo criteria: 2 passed, 1 failed (real bug — service-card-modelaz-nehtu still serves an external static.prod-images URL, not /nehty/*, violating the literal acceptance criterion even though the image itself loads fine).

bugs.criterion: Karty služeb a galerie používají fotky z /nehty/ a načtou se
bugs.description: service-card-modelaz-nehtu renders an with src 'https://static.prod-images.emergentagent.com/jobs/.../343b9a2a...jpeg' instead of a '/nehty/...' path. Image itself loads correctly (naturalWidth=1264), so it is a data-state/spec-compliance mismatch, not a broken render. Source: NAIL_PHOTOS.modelaz in /app/frontend/src/lib/photos.ts still points to the old external emergentagent static URL while every other service (manikura, gelLak, nailArt, pedikura) and all 4 gallery images already use /nehty/*.jpg from the client's uploaded photos.
bugs.evidence: run_browser_script 'service-and-gallery-photos-nehty': collected srcs — klasicka-manikura=/nehty/nude-detail-4.jpg, gel-lak=/nehty/nude-matte-almond.jpg, modelaz-nehtu=https://static.prod-images.emergentagent.com/jobs/38975200-.../343b9a2a....jpeg (w=1264), nail-art=/nehty/gold-flower-silk.jpg, pedikura=/nehty/sage-gold-silk.jpg, gallery(4)=all /nehty/*.jpg. Also confirmed by pre-existing persisted check 'service-photo-modelaz-updated.mjs' which explicitly asserts this card's img src includes 'static.prod-images.emergentagent.com' — i.e. this was a deliberate prior choice, now conflicting with the newer matrix wording.

notes: hero-no-floating-cutouts and hero-photos-correct-src-load are brand-new checks confirming the fix: NAIL_PHOTOS.heroLeft/heroRight in /app/frontend/src/lib/photos.ts now point to '/nehty/velvet-nude-hands.jpg' and '/nehty/floral-art-hands.jpg', and no remains inside #hero (the cutout nails/hand PNGs are still used, by design, only in #kolekce per spec_deviations/seed_facts).

The one failing check (service-and-gallery-photos-nehty) surfaces a real, low-severity leftover: NAIL_PHOTOS.modelaz in photos.ts is the only remaining photo across service cards + gallery not sourced from /app/frontend/public/nehty; a pre-existing persisted check (service-photo-modelaz-updated.mjs) explicitly encoded this as intentional in an earlier iteration, but it now conflicts with the current matrix's literal wording ('Všechny ... mají src začínající /nehty/'). Flagging as a bug for main agent to either swap in a /nehty/ photo for modelaz-nehtu or confirm intentional exception.
Backend suite (3 files, 5 tests) passed clean in 7.26s; unchanged from prior iteration.
spec_deviations honored: calendar_synced=false expected; AI design image generation out of scope.
